channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Is Russia’s economy cracking despite the Iran war windfall?
item.description: A widening deficit and Ukrainian strikes are testing Russia's economy, even as war in the Middle East lifts oil revenue.

item.title: Iran remains defiant as it vows to fight US until demands met
item.description: IRGC advisers say Iran has replaced more missiles and drones than it used, and cite falling US munition stocks.

item.title: As Strait of Hormuz transit drops, Trump again says US has ‘control’
item.description: Just eight vessels crossed strait on Tuesday, down from 130 to 140 prior to the war as peace talks stall.

item.title: Iran is not anti-imperialist. It is a state calculating survival
item.description: Regardless of its current hostile rhetoric, the Islamic Republic will likely reach a settlement with the US and Israel.

item.title: Why has North Korea fired a missile before US-South Korea drills?
item.description: Pyongyang has repeatedly condemned US–South Korea military drills, claiming they are a 'rehearsal for invasion'.

item.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
item.description: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.

item.title: Members of Trump's cabinet remained on decoy plane, after president's quiet exit
item.description: Trump boarded a different plane in Turkey during a Nato summit for security reasons involving Iran.

item.title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
item.description: US Central Command says its helicopter hit the engine room of a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.

item.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
item.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

item.title: In shattered Cali, residents search for loved ones and signs of hope
item.description: Most deaths from the magnitude-7.4 quake were reported in Cali, Colombia’s third-most populous city, as crews search collapsed buildings for those still trapped.
